js: 'SETUP: a dev instance on a copy of a dev database with an Image lab row image/z-image-turbo (the z-image-turbo recipe) and two CPU audio rows, audio/kokoro (kokoro_tts, offline) and audio/canary (canary_asr), their files in the copy own models dirs inside its data dir (labs-store design §5). Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/lab-store-media.json --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --token-file <scratch>.token --podman-guard "" --shots <dir>. The guard is off because the drive generates on image/z-image-turbo (a GPU container) and speaks on audio/kokoro (a CPU container). It clears both labs and their presets first; then on each page: an ask kept across a reload with its file served from the lab store, a preset saved and loaded, Open in form, delete; on the Image lab a generation whose group is in front, in flight, from its creation, its Delete off, through a history reload (the model filter) until its picture lands; on the Audio lab also a transcription of the kept clip, its upload the group input, opened in the form, and a Stop of a long synthesis that settles its group as stopped (kokoro cannot stream: its engine answers Kokoro TTS only supports offline sessions); and both labs cleared again.'

(async()=>{for(const lab of ['image','audio']){await fetch('/labs/api/'+lab+'/clear',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:'null'});const l=await (await fetch('/labs/api/'+lab+'/presets')).json();for(const p of l.presets){await fetch('/labs/api/'+lab+'/presets/'+p.id+'/delete',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:'null'})}}return 'cleared'})()

expect: document.querySelector('.results-note').textContent.startsWith('newest first · kept') && document.querySelector('.results-list .empty').textContent.includes('kept on the server until you delete it') && document.querySelector('.lp-card')
label: image: the results are the kept history, and the form has a presets card

js: (async()=>{const g=(await (await fetch('/labs/api/audio/groups')).json()).groups[0];const a=g.runs[0].artifacts[0];const blob=await (await fetch(a.href)).blob();const form={task:'asr',asr:{source:'upload',file_name:'kept-clip.wav'}};const made=await (await fetch('/audio-lab/api/groups',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'audio/canary',route:'transcription',form})})).json();const fd=new FormData();fd.append('model','audio/canary');fd.append('file',new File([blob],'kept-clip.wav',{type:'audio/wav'}));const r=await fetch('/audio-lab/api/transcriptions?group='+made.id,{method:'POST',body:fd});return r.status+' '+(await r.text()).slice(0,120)})()
